mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Turnkey cloud apps with the least infrastructure management = SaaS.

stem.zh: 技术人员需要查明一台激光打印机为什么间歇性无法进纸打印。技术人员通过运行多次复印和打印测试验证了该问题。技术人员接下来应该怎么做？
stem.en: A technician needs to figure out why a laser printer is intermittently not feeding paper to print. The technician verifies the issue by running several copy-and-print tests. Which of the following should the technician do next?

explanation.zh:
【考点：激光打印机进纸故障（搓纸轮 Pickup Rollers）】
当激光打印机间歇性无法进纸（Not feeding paper）时，最常见的硬件原因是搓纸轮（Pickup rollers）积灰、老化磨损或表面光滑导致摩擦力下降，无法从纸盒中抓起纸张。因此，清洁（或更换）搓纸轮是正确的下一步操作。更新打印机驱动、选择纸张尺寸或更换硒鼓（Toner cartridge）均无法解决机械抓纸打滑问题。
explanation.en: When a laser printer intermittently fails to feed paper from the tray, the most common cause is dusty, glazed, or worn pickup rollers that lose traction on the paper, so cleaning (or replacing) the pickup rollers is the correct next step. Updating printer drivers, changing paper size settings, or replacing the toner cartridge will not fix a mechanical paper pickup issue confirmed during local copy-and-print tests.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：打印机间歇性不进纸/抓不起纸，清洁或更换搓纸轮（Pickup rollers）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Printer intermittently not feeding/picking up paper = Clean or replace the pickup rollers.

stem.zh: 一位用户报告在开放式办公室中遇到间歇性 Wi-Fi 连接问题，而其他用户均未受影响。最可能的原因是什么？
stem.en: A user reports intermittent Wi-Fi issues in an open office. Other users are not affected. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: All users are on the same frequency
The laptop’s wireless card is malfunctioning
The antenna is near a device creating electromagnetic interference

explanation.zh:
【考点：无线网络故障排查（单点故障定位）】
由于开放式办公室内的其他用户均未受影响，说明无线接入点（AP）和网络环境正常，故障范围缩小到该用户的客户端设备本身，最可能的原因是笔记本电脑的无线网卡（Wireless NIC）出现故障（C正确）。其他Wi-Fi信号干扰（A）、同频段拥塞（B）以及天线附近的电磁干扰（EMI，D）属于环境或网络级问题，通常会影响同一区域的多个用户，而非仅限于单台设备。
explanation.en: Since only one user is experiencing Wi-Fi issues in an open office where everyone else has stable connectivity, the fault is isolated to the client device—most likely a malfunctioning wireless NIC. Network-wide issues such as signal interference, frequency congestion, or nearby electromagnetic interference (EMI) near the access point antenna would affect multiple users simultaneously rather than just a single laptop.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：一人断网查网卡，众人断网查AP与干扰。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: One user affected = client device issue (NIC); many users affected = network/AP/interference issue.

stem.zh: 一名技术员正在组装一台高性能工作站。当技术员尝试启动该工作站时，电脑毫无反应。技术员确认所有电源连接器均已完全插紧。以下哪项最可能是导致该问题的原因？
stem.en: A technician is building a high-powered workstation. When the technician attempts to start the workstation, nothing happens. The technician verifies that all power connectors are fully seated. Which of the following is the most likely cause of the issue?

options.text: The case header pins are not connected.
The RAM is not fully seated.
The power supply unit’s wattage is too low.
The CPU fan connector is faulty

explanation.zh:
【考点：台式机组装与开机无反应排查】
当新组装的工作站按下电源键后毫无反应（风扇不转、指示灯不亮），且已确认主板和CPU等所有主供电接口均已插紧时，最可能的原因是机箱前面板跳线（Case header pins，特别是电源开关 PWR_SW 引脚）未连接或插错位置，导致主板无法接收到开机触发信号（A正确）。内存未插紧（B）或CPU风扇接口故障（D）通常仍会有通电迹象或风扇短暂转动并报警；电源功率不足（C）一般表现为高负载下重启或无法通过自检，而非完全不通电。
explanation.en: When a newly built workstation shows no response at all upon pressing the power button—even after verifying all PSU power cables are seated—the most likely cause is that the front-panel case header pins (specifically PWR_SW) are not connected or are plugged into the wrong motherboard header pins. Unseated RAM or a faulty CPU fan connector would still allow the system to receive power or attempt to start, while low PSU wattage typically causes instability or shutdowns under load rather than complete dead-on-arrival behavior.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：新装机供电插紧却按开机毫无反应，必查机箱前面板跳线（Case header pins）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: New build + PSU cables seated + totally dead when pressing power = check front-panel case header pins.

stem.zh: 一位用户在使用电脑时遇到随机蓝屏死机（BSOD），但操作系统随后能正常恢复。以下哪种症状表明该问题与内存（RAM）有关？
stem.en: A user experiences a random BSOD while using a computer, but the operating system recovers as expected Which of the following symptoms would indicate the issue is related to RAM?

explanation.zh:
【考点：内存（RAM）故障症状与诊断】
在开机自检（POST）期间，BIOS/UEFI 会检测包括内存（RAM）在内的关键硬件；如果内存存在故障，主板通常会发出特定的 POST 蜂鸣代码（Beep codes），同时内存故障也是导致系统运行中出现随机蓝屏死机（BSOD）的典型原因（D正确）。错误的 BIOS 配置（A）通常导致无法引导而非随机蓝屏；持续重启（B）可能由多种软硬件原因引起，无法直接指向内存；电容鼓包（C）属于主板或电源硬件损坏的特征，与内存条本身无关。
explanation.en: During the Power-On Self-Test (POST), the system checks critical hardware components like RAM and emits POST beep codes if memory defects are detected, which also aligns with random Blue Screens of Death (BSODs). Wrong BIOS configurations typically prevent booting altogether, continuous reboots are too generic to pinpoint RAM specifically, and distended (bulging) capacitors indicate a failing motherboard or power regulation circuit rather than faulty RAM modules.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：随机蓝屏加开机蜂鸣（POST beeps），直指内存（RAM）故障。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Random BSODs + POST beep codes = classic signs of failing RAM.

stem.zh: 如果附近可能存在电磁干扰（EMI），应该安装以下哪种线缆？
stem.en: Which of the following cables should be installed if nearby electromagnetic interference is a possibility?

explanation.zh:
【考点：网络线缆类型与抗电磁干扰（STP vs. UTP）】
屏蔽双绞线（STP，Shielded Twisted Pair）内部包含金属箔或编织网屏蔽层，专门用于抵御环境中的电磁干扰（EMI）和射频干扰（RFI），保障数据信号完整性（A正确）。非屏蔽双绞线（UTP，B）没有金属屏蔽层，在强电磁干扰环境下容易出现丢包和信号衰减；Thunderbolt（C）和 USB（D）属于外设连接线缆，并非用于综合布线的局域网抗干扰网线。
explanation.en: Shielded Twisted Pair (STP) cabling includes conductive foil or braided shielding around the wire pairs to protect network transmissions against electromagnetic interference (EMI) and radio frequency interference (RFI). Unshielded Twisted Pair (UTP) lacks metallic shielding and is vulnerable to heavy EMI, while Thunderbolt and USB are short-range peripheral interconnects rather than structured network cabling solutions.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：强电磁干扰（EMI）布线选屏蔽双绞线（STP）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: High EMI/RFI environment = install STP (Shielded Twisted Pair) cabling.

stem.zh: 一位用户在手机上安装新的电子邮件应用时收到错误提示。技术员确认操作系统已更新且该应用受支持。技术员接下来应该检查什么？
stem.en: A user receives an error when installing a new email app on their phone. Technician verifies OS is updated and app is supported. What should the technician check next?

explanation.zh:
【考点：移动设备应用安装故障排查】
当智能手机操作系统已更新且确认应用受支持，但安装新应用仍报错时，技术员接下来首先应检查手机的可用存储空间（Storage），因为应用下载、解压和缓存需要足够的剩余容量（A正确）。电池健康度（B）不会阻止应用安装；SIM卡（C）仅用于蜂窝网络身份认证；处理器架构（D）属于兼容性范畴，题干已确认该应用受设备支持。
explanation.en: When a supported app fails to install on an updated smartphone, the technician should next check available device storage, as downloading and unpacking installation files requires sufficient free space. Battery health does not block app store installations, the SIM card only handles cellular subscriber authentication, and processor compatibility was already confirmed when verifying that the app is supported.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：手机系统兼容却装不上App，下一步优先查存储空间（Storage）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Supported mobile app fails to install on updated OS = check free storage space next.

stem.zh: 技术员在 DNS 中应该使用以下哪项将设备映射到 IPv6 地址？
stem.en: Which of the following should a technician use in DNS to map a device to an IPv6 address?

explanation.zh:
【考点：DNS 记录类型（AAAA 记录）】
在 DNS 中，AAAA（Quad-A）记录专门用于将主机名或完全限定域名（FQDN）映射到 128 位的 IPv6 地址（C正确）。A 记录（A）用于将域名映射到 32 位的 IPv4 地址；CNAME 记录（B）用于创建指向另一个域名的别名；MX 记录（D）用于指定接收电子邮件的邮件交换服务器。
explanation.en: An AAAA (Quad-A) record is used in DNS to map a hostname or fully qualified domain name (FQDN) to a 128-bit IPv6 address. By contrast, an A record maps a hostname to a 32-bit IPv4 address, a CNAME record creates an alias pointing one domain name to another, and an MX record directs domain email to mail servers.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：一个A（A记录）对应IPv4，四个A（AAAA记录）对应IPv6。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: DNS A record = IPv4 (32-bit); AAAA record = IPv6 (128-bit, 4x larger).

stem.zh: 一名技术员正在为内部开发人员搭建本地托管环境，这些人员需要同时并发访问多种测试操作系统（OS）。以下哪项最能满足这一需求？
stem.en: A technician is setting up a locally hosted environment for internal developers who need concurrent access to a wide array of test OSs. Which of the following would best fulfill this requirement?

explanation.zh:
【考点：虚拟化技术与管理程序（Hypervisor）】
虚拟机管理程序（Hypervisor）允许在单台本地物理主机上同时运行多个独立的虚拟机（VM）和不同的操作系统，完美满足内部开发人员并发访问多种测试操作系统的需求（A正确）。SaaS 平台（B）是基于云端的软件服务，不符合本地托管多种操作系统的要求；多系统引导服务器（Multiboot，C）每次只能启动一个操作系统，无法实现并发访问；沙箱（Sandbox，D）主要用于隔离测试单个可疑程序或代码，而非提供多用户并发的多操作系统宿主环境。
explanation.en: A hypervisor enables multiple virtual machines running different operating systems to execute concurrently on a single locally hosted physical server, allowing multiple developers to access various test OSs simultaneously. A SaaS platform is cloud-hosted software rather than a local OS testbed, a multiboot server can only run one OS at a time, and a sandbox is an isolated environment for testing untrusted code rather than hosting concurrent multi-OS sessions.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：本地同时并发运行多套操作系统，必选虚拟化管理程序（Hypervisor）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Concurrent access to multiple OSs on local hardware = Hypervisor.

stem.zh: 一位客户可以使用其 USB 喷墨打印机打印大多数文档，但在从某定制应用程序打印特定报表时系统无响应。除非重启电脑并重启打印机电源，否则无法打印任何内容。技术员远程连接到该 PC，确认发送该报表时打印后台处理程序（Spooler）停止工作。在清理后台处理程序并从制造商网站重新安装驱动程序后，问题依然存在。使用该应用程序的其他站点均未报告类似问题。以下哪项最可能是导致该问题的原因？
stem.en: A customer is able to print most documents with their USB inkjet printer, but the system is unresponsive when printing a certain report from a custom application. Nothing will print until the computer is restarted and the printer is power cycled. A technician remotes into the PC and confirms that the spooler stops working when this report is sent. After cleaning the spooler and reinstalling the drivers from the manufacturer's website, the issue persists. No other sites using the application report similar issues. Which of the following is most likely causing the issue?

options.text: The manufacturer is curating content before it reaches the device to preserve ink.
The application has a bug that the developer needs to address.
The system is using the PostScript language instead of the PCL.
Personal preferences have changed and documents with graphics are now online-only

explanation.zh:
【考点：打印故障排查（特定应用程序导致的后台打印程序崩溃）】
该打印机可以正常打印大多数文档，仅在打印某款定制应用程序的特定报表时导致打印后台处理程序（Print Spooler）卡死，且清空打印队列并重装官方驱动后问题依旧，说明硬件和系统驱动均正常，最可能的原因是该定制应用程序存在软件缺陷（Bug），发送了格式错误的打印数据，需要开发人员修复（B正确）。厂商为省墨审查内容（A）和个人偏好把带图文档变成仅在线（D）纯属臆造干扰项；頁面描述语言使用 PostScript 还是 PCL（C）由驱动程序管理，重装正确驱动后不会只针对单一定制报表崩溃。
explanation.en: Because the printer works normally for other documents and fails only when printing a specific report from a custom application—even after clearing the spooler and reinstalling manufacturer drivers—the issue is most likely caused by a software bug in that custom application sending malformed print data. The other options are fabricated or irrelevant scenarios that would either affect all print jobs or do not crash the local print spooler.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：其他文档打印正常唯独定制软件某报表卡死Spooler，定是应用本身有Bug。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Prints fine everywhere except one custom app/report = application bug.

stem.zh: 一台网络打印机持续输出字迹暗淡的打印件。用户报告称，在不同的电脑和打印任务中该问题均存在。技术员首先应该采取以下哪个步骤？
stem.en: A network printer consistently produces faint printouts. Users report that the issue persists across different computers and print jobs. Which of the following steps should the technician take first?

explanation.zh:
【考点：激光打印机故障排查（字迹暗淡）】
网络打印机在不同电脑和不同打印任务下均持续出现打印字迹暗淡（Faint printouts），说明问题出在打印机耗材本身，最常见且首先应采取的步骤是更换碳粉盒（Toner cartridge，B正确）。校准打印机（A）主要用于解决色彩偏移或对齐问题；重装驱动程序（C）仅适用于单台电脑打印异常的情况；调整定影器温度（D）用于处理碳粉未定影（一擦就掉）的问题，而非整体字迹变淡。
explanation.en: Consistent faint printouts across multiple computers and print jobs on a network laser printer indicate a hardware consumable issue—most commonly a low or depleted toner cartridge that needs replacement. Reinstalling drivers would only help if the issue were isolated to one computer, while running calibration or adjusting fuser temperature deals with color alignment or toner bonding rather than overall faded print density.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：激光打印全员字迹变淡（Faint），第一步先换碳粉盒（Toner）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Faint printouts across all users on a laser printer = replace the toner cartridge first.

stem.zh: 以下哪项工具用于验证以太网网卡（Ethernet NIC）的功能是否正常？
stem.en: Which of the following is used to verify the functionality of an Ethernet NIC?

explanation.zh:
【考点：网络硬件测试工具（环回插头 Loopback plug）】
环回插头（Loopback plug）专门用于将以太网网卡（NIC）的发送引脚（TX）直接环回连接到接收引脚（RX），从而验证物理网卡端口的收发功能是否正常（B正确）。寻线仪/音频发生器与探头（Toner probe，A）用于在复杂线束或墙体中追踪线缆；Wi-Fi 分析仪（C）用于检测无线信道和信号强度；打线刀（Punchdown tool，D）用于将双绞线压接端接到配线架（Patch panel）或信息模块上。
explanation.en: A loopback plug is used to verify the physical and data-link functionality of an Ethernet NIC by routing its transmit (TX) pins directly back to its receive (RX) pins to test whether the port can send and receive signals properly. A toner probe traces cables inside walls, a Wi-Fi analyzer evaluates wireless spectrum channels, and a punchdown tool terminates wires into a patch panel or keystone jack.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：测网卡（NIC）收发好坏，插环回插头（Loopback plug）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Loopback plug = tests physical NIC port TX/RX functionality.

stem.zh: 一台 IP 地址为 169.254.34.24 的设备无法访问互联网网站。以下哪项最可能是导致该问题的原因？
stem.en: A device with an IP address of 169.254.34.24 is having trouble accessing internet websites. Which of the following is most likely causing the issue?

options.text: The static IP address configuration is incorrect.
The DHCP assignment cannot be obtained.
The internet is disconnected from the router.

explanation.zh:
【考点：APIPA 地址（169.254.x.x）与 DHCP 故障】
设备出现 169.254.x.x 网段的 IP 地址，说明触发了自动专用 IP 寻址（APIPA），这是当客户端开启了自动获取 IP 但无法联系到 DHCP 服务器获取有效地址租约时自行分配的链路本地地址；由于没有分配默认网关，设备无法访问互联网（C正确）。静态 IP 配置错误（A）不会产生自动分配的 APIPA 地址；DNS 解析失败（B）或路由器外网断开（D）时，客户端仍能从本地 DHCP 获取正常的局域网 IP 地址。
explanation.en: An IP address in the 169.254.0.0/16 range is an Automatic Private IP Addressing (APIPA) address, which a device self-assigns when it is configured for DHCP but cannot contact a DHCP server to obtain a valid IP lease. Because APIPA provides no default gateway, the device cannot route traffic to the internet. Incorrect static IP settings, DNS failures, or a disconnected WAN link on the router would not cause the client to assign itself a 169.254.x.x address.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：见到 169.254 开头（APIPA），必是 DHCP 获取失败。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: 169.254.x.x = APIPA = DHCP server unreachable / assignment failed.

stem.zh: 一名技术员收到一台内部似乎有隆起的平板电脑。该隆起正将屏幕从背板上顶开。平板电脑在插着电源时仍能开机，但屏幕看起来已损坏，且拔掉电源后就会关机。以下哪项最可能是导致此问题的原因？
stem.en: A technician receives a tablet that looks like it has a bulge inside. The bulge is pushing the screen away from the backplate. The tablet still turns on when it is plugged in, but the screen looks damaged and turns off when unplugged. Which of the following is the most likely cause of this issue?

explanation.zh:
【考点：移动设备电池鼓包（Swollen/Deprecated Battery）】
平板电脑内部隆起并将屏幕顶离后盖，同时拔掉电源就断电，这是锂离子电池严重老化、失效并发生鼓包（Swollen/Deprecated battery）的典型特征，存在破裂或起火的安全隐患（C正确）。电源适配器故障（A）、充电端口损坏（B）或单纯的屏幕破裂（D）都不会导致机身内部产生膨胀隆起并撑开屏幕。
explanation.en: A physical bulge pushing the tablet screen away from the backplate, combined with the device shutting off immediately when unplugged, indicates a swollen and degraded (deprecated) lithium-ion battery. This is a critical safety hazard requiring immediate care. A malfunctioning external power supply, damaged charge port, or broken screen alone would not cause internal swelling of the chassis.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：机身鼓包顶起屏幕且拔电即关机，定是电池老化鼓包。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Bulging casing/screen separation + dies when unplugged = swollen/degraded battery.

stem.zh: 以下哪种设备能够处理大量数据并使用闪存（Flash memory）？
stem.en: Which of the following devices can handle large volumes of data and uses flash memory?

explanation.zh:
【考点：存储设备类型（SSD 闪存存储）】
固态硬盘（SSD，Solid-State Drive）使用非易失性 NAND 闪存（Flash memory）芯片来存储数据，无机械运动部件，能够高速处理大容量数据（A正确）。DVD-RW（B）属于容量较小的光学存储介质；机械硬盘（HDD，C）使用旋转的磁性盘片存储数据；磁带（Tape，D）使用磁性卷带进行顺序读写归档，三者均不使用闪存。
explanation.en: A Solid-State Drive (SSD) uses non-volatile NAND flash memory chips to store and process large volumes of data rapidly with no moving parts. By contrast, a DVD-RW uses optical laser media with small capacity, a Hard Disk Drive (HDD) uses spinning magnetic platters, and tape drives use magnetic tape reels for sequential archival storage.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：大容量加闪存（Flash memory）无机械部件，必选固态硬盘（SSD）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: High-capacity storage + NAND flash memory (no moving parts) = SSD.

stem.zh: 一位用户的智能手机频繁断开 Wi-Fi 网络连接，尤其是在机场和咖啡馆等人员密集场所。该用户还注意到，在同一位置，自己设备显示的 Wi-Fi 信号强度低于其他设备。以下哪项最可能导致了该智能手机的 Wi-Fi 连接问题？
stem.en: A user's smartphone frequently disconnects from Wi-Fi networks, particularly in crowded areas like airports and coffee shops. The user also notices that their device shows a lower Wi-Fi signal strength compared to other devices in the same location. Which of the following is likely contributing to the smartphone's Wi-Fi connectivity issues?

options.text: The smartphone's antenna may be malfunctioning.
The smartphone may have an outdated Wi-Fi standard.
The smartphone may be experiencing interference from nearby devices.
The smartphone's power settings may be affecting performance.

explanation.zh:
【考点：移动设备无线连接故障（内置天线损坏）】
当用户的智能手机在机场、咖啡馆等场所频繁断开 Wi-Fi，且在同一位置下其显示的 Wi-Fi 信号强度明显低于周围其他设备时，说明外部无线网络正常，最可能的原因是该手机内部的 Wi-Fi 天线出现故障或接触不良（A正确）。无线标准较旧（B）主要影响最高协商速率而非信号格数；周围设备干扰（C）会同时影响同位置的其它设备；电源设置（D）通常不会导致单个设备信号强度明显弱于旁边的设备。
explanation.en: When a smartphone consistently shows weaker Wi-Fi signal strength and frequent drops compared to other devices in the exact same location, the most likely cause is a malfunctioning or loose internal Wi-Fi antenna. Environmental interference would impact nearby devices similarly, an outdated Wi-Fi standard wouldn't reduce received signal bars on compatible bands, and mobile power settings rarely throttle Wi-Fi antenna reception in active use.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：同地段唯独本机信号格数低且易断连，优先排查手机内置天线（Antenna）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Lower Wi-Fi signal bars than other devices in the exact same spot = faulty internal antenna.

stem.zh: 一名管理员需要保护一台老旧但对业务至关重要的物理服务器。该服务器运行的软件已不再受维护，且不需要访问互联网。管理员应采取以下哪项措施来最好地满足这一需求？
stem.en: An administrator needs to secure a legacy, business-critical physical server. The server runs software that is no longer maintained and does not require internet access. Which of the following actions should the administrator take to best meet this requirement?

options.text: Upgrade to the latest operating system.
Migrate the application data to a SaaS provider.
Perform a final backup and decommission the server.
Virtualize the server and move it to an air-gapped network.

explanation.zh:
【考点：老旧系统安全加固与虚拟化隔离（P2V + Air-gapped）】
针对运行着不再维护软件但仍属于业务关键型的老旧物理服务器，最佳做法是将其虚拟化（P2V，摆脱对老化物理硬件的依赖），并将其放置在物理隔离网络（Air-gapped network）中，利用其无需访问互联网的特点彻底隔绝外部网络攻击（D正确）。升级到最新操作系统（A）极易导致无维护的老旧软件因不兼容而瘫痪；仅将数据迁移到 SaaS（B）无法保留应用程序本身；停用并下线服务器（C）违背了维持关键业务继续运行的要求。
explanation.en: To secure a business-critical legacy server running unmaintained software that needs no internet access, the administrator should convert the physical server to a virtual machine (P2V virtualization) and isolate it on an air-gapped network. Upgrading the OS would likely break legacy software compatibility, migrating only data to SaaS does not preserve the custom application functionality, and decommissioning the server fails the requirement to keep the business-critical system operational.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：关键老旧服务不需联网，虚拟化（Virtualize）后放入物理隔离网（Air-gapped）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Unmaintained legacy server + no internet needed = Virtualize (P2V) + isolate on an air-gapped network.

stem.zh: 以下哪些属于射频（RF）连接？（选两项）
stem.en: Which of the following are radio frequency connections? (Select two.)

explanation.zh:
【考点：广域网连接介质（射频 RF 无线连接）】
卫星网络（Satellite）和蜂窝移动网络（Cellular，如 4G/5G）均通过空中无线电射频（RF，Radio Frequency）电磁波传输数据（B、D正确）。有线电视宽带（Cable，A）使用同轴电缆；数字用户线路（DSL，C）使用电话铜线；以太网（Ethernet，E）使用双绞线铜缆；光纤（Fiber，F）使用光脉冲在玻璃或塑料纤维中传输，均不属于射频连接。
explanation.en: Satellite and cellular connections are wireless WAN technologies that transmit data over the air using radio frequency (RF) electromagnetic waves. By contrast, cable uses coaxial copper lines, DSL uses copper telephone wires, Ethernet uses twisted-pair copper cabling, and fiber-optic connections transmit pulses of light through glass or plastic strands.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：射频（RF）无线传数据，卫星（Satellite）与蜂窝（Cellular）两兄弟。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Wireless RF WAN connections = Satellite and Cellular (Cable/DSL/Ethernet = copper; Fiber = light).

stem.zh: 一位用户报告其桌面打印机的打印质量很差。技术员更换了墨盒，但未能解决该问题。技术员接下来应该怎么做？
stem.en: A user reports that the print quality of their desk printer is poor. A technician replaces the ink cartridge, but this does not resolve the issue. Which of the following should the technician do next?

explanation.zh:
【考点：喷墨打印机故障排查（清洗打印头 Printheads）】
桌面喷墨打印机在更换新墨盒（Ink cartridge）后打印质量仍然很差（如出现断线、条纹或色彩缺失），最常见的原因是干涸的墨水堵塞了喷嘴，因此技术员下一步应该清洗打印头（Clean the printheads，B正确）。更换搓纸轮（Pickup rollers，A）用于解决卡纸或无法进纸问题；更换纸张类型（C）不是换墨盒后质量依然差的标准排查步骤；色带（Ribbon，D）是针式击打打印机（Impact printer）的耗材，不用于喷墨打印机。
explanation.en: When an inkjet desk printer continues to produce poor print quality (such as streaks or missing colors) right after replacing the ink cartridge, the next troubleshooting step is to clean the printheads, which often become clogged with dried ink. Pickup rollers deal with paper feeding issues rather than print quality, switching paper type is unnecessary for standard jobs, and ribbons are only used in impact (dot-matrix) printers.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：喷墨机换完新墨盒打印质量依然差，下一步立即清洗打印头（Printheads）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Inkjet print quality still poor after new ink cartridge = clean the printheads next.

stem.zh: 技术员应该创建以下哪项，以便使用 DHCP 为一台 PC 分配永久 IP 地址？
stem.en: Which of the following should a technician create to assign a permanent IP address to a PC using DHCP?

explanation.zh:
【考点：DHCP 保留（DHCP Reservation）】
要在继续使用 DHCP 自动管理的同时为特定 PC 分配固定的永久 IP 地址，技术员需要在 DHCP 服务器上创建地址保留（Reservation），将该设备的 MAC 地址与特定 IP 地址绑定，使其每次请求时都获得同一个 IP（A正确）。租约（Lease，B）具有时效性，到期后 IP 可能会改变；排除范围（Exclusion，C）只是将某些 IP 从地址池中剔除不作动态分配，并不会将其分配给指定设备；作用域选项（Scope option，D）用于下发默认网关、DNS 服务器等附加网络参数。
explanation.en: A DHCP reservation binds a specific IP address to a device's MAC address on the DHCP server, ensuring the PC always receives the same permanent IP address dynamically via DHCP. A normal lease is temporary and can change upon expiration, an exclusion simply removes an IP range from the DHCP pool without assigning it to a client, and a scope option configures network parameters like default gateway or DNS servers.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：通过 DHCP 绑定 MAC 分配固定永久 IP，叫做地址保留（Reservation）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Permanent/fixed IP assigned automatically via DHCP (bound to MAC) = DHCP Reservation.

stem.zh: 一名工程师必须实施一项解决方案，以便在组织的老旧应用程序退役之前对其进行支持和维护。该应用程序目前托管在三台物理服务器上。以下哪个概念最合适？
stem.en: An engineer must implement a solution to facilitate and maintain an organization's legacy application until it is retired. The application is currently hosted on three physical servers. Which of the following is the most suitable concept?

explanation.zh:
【考点：虚拟化应用场景（老旧应用维护与服务器整合）】
当组织需要维持运行在多台物理服务器上的老旧应用程序直至其退役时，最合适的概念是虚拟化（Virtualization），工程师可以通过物理机转虚拟机（P2V）将三台旧服务器整合到虚拟化宿主平台上，消除老旧物理硬件故障风险并简化备份与维护（C正确）。存储区域网络（SAN，A）仅解决块级存储问题；函数即服务（FaaS，B）属于无服务器云原生架构，不适用于直接托管传统多服务器老旧应用；配置管理平台（D）用于自动化批量配置，无法替代老化物理服务器硬件。
explanation.en: Virtualization allows an engineer to convert the three aging physical servers into virtual machines (P2V migration) hosted on modern consolidated hardware, preserving the legacy application environment until retirement while reducing hardware maintenance overhead. A SAN only provides block-level network storage, Function as a Service (FaaS) is for cloud-native serverless code rather than legacy multi-server apps, and a configuration management platform automates provisioning rather than abstracting aging physical servers.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：多台旧物理服务器维护老旧应用至退役，首选虚拟化（Virtualization）整合。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Maintaining legacy multi-server apps until retirement = Virtualization (P2V consolidation).

stem.zh: 以下哪项是专门设计用于商业空间的？
stem.en: Which of the following is designed to be used in commercial spaces?

explanation.zh:
【考点：商业建筑通风层阻燃线缆（Plenum cabling）】
通风层阻燃线缆（Plenum cabling）采用特殊的阻燃、低烟无毒外护套材料，专门设计用于商业建筑的通风回风空间（如吊顶上方或架空地板下方的空气流通层），符合商业空间严格的消防安全规范（C正确）。USB 3.1 Gen 2（A）是短距离外设接口标准；ST 光纤连接器（B）和 Cat 8 网线（D）仅代表接口形态或高速传输等级，本身不代表专门针对商业建筑通风空间的消防安全阻燃等级。
explanation.en: Plenum cabling is specifically designed with fire-retardant, low-smoke outer jackets (such as fluorinated ethylene propylene) for installation in commercial building plenum air-handling spaces (above drop ceilings or below raised floors) to comply with building fire codes. USB 3.1 Gen 2, ST fiber connectors, and Cat 8 define interface speeds or connector types rather than commercial fire-safety air-duct ratings.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：商业建筑吊顶通风层布线，必选防火低烟的通风层线缆（Plenum cabling）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Commercial building air ducts / drop ceilings = Plenum-rated cabling (fire-resistant, low toxic smoke).

stem.zh: 在用于空气通风的吊顶内布放铜质网络线缆时，必须使用以下哪种线缆类型？
stem.en: Which of the following cable types must be used when running copper network cable through a suspended ceiling that is used for air ventilation?

explanation.zh:
【考点：线缆防火等级（Plenum 阻燃线缆）】
在用作空气流通/通风管道的吊顶空间（Plenum space）中布放铜缆时，消防法规要求必须使用阻燃等级（Plenum-rated，即 CMP）线缆，其外皮采用低烟无卤阻燃材料，可防止火灾时通过通风系统扩散有毒浓烟。普通 PVC 护套的双绞线（Twisted pair）燃烧时会产生大量毒烟；多模（Multimode）属于光纤而非铜缆；同轴电缆（Coaxial）是线缆结构类型而非防火护套等级。
explanation.en: When installing copper network cabling in air-handling spaces such as suspended ceilings used for HVAC ventilation, building and fire codes require plenum-rated (CMP) cable. Plenum cable uses specialized low-smoke, fire-retardant insulation that limits toxic fumes if burned, whereas standard PVC twisted-pair cable releases hazardous smoke. Multimode refers to fiber-optic cabling rather than copper, and coaxial is a physical cable type rather than a fire-safety jacket rating.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：通风吊顶走网线，必选 Plenum 低烟阻燃线。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Air ventilation ceiling or HVAC duct = always choose Plenum-rated cable.

stem.zh: 技术人员最可能使用以下哪种工具来识别未贴标签的网络连接？
stem.en: Which of the following tools will a technician most likely use to identify an unlabeled network connection?

explanation.zh:
【考点：网络布线工具（寻线仪 Toner Probe）】
寻线仪（Toner probe，由音频发生器和探头组成）专门用于追踪和定位无标签的网线：将发生器接在线缆一端发送音频信号，用探头在配线架或线束另一端感应声音即可找到对应网线。测线仪（Cable tester）用于检测线序和通断，但要求已知两端位置；环回插头（Loopback plug）用于测试本地网卡端口；网络分路器（Network tap）用于流量抓包监听。
explanation.en: A toner probe (tone generator and probe kit) is designed to trace and identify unlabeled cables across walls, ceilings, and patch panels by sending an audible tone down the wire from one end and detecting it at the other. A cable tester verifies pinouts and continuity once both ends are already known, a loopback plug tests local NIC port functionality, and a network tap passively intercepts traffic for monitoring.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：网线无标找哪根，Toner probe 寻线听声音。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Unlabeled cable in a bundle or patch panel = trace it with a Toner probe.

stem.zh: 某公司计划在一年后淘汰一款旧版应用程序，但希望现在就停用物理环境。以下哪种迁移方法最合适？
stem.en: A company will retire a legacy application in one year but wants to decommission the physical environment now. Which migration method is best?

options.text: Relocating the server to a colocated data center
Performing a physical-to-virtual conversion and hosting on IaaS
Taking a backup and shutting down the server

explanation.zh:
【考点：虚拟化迁移与云服务模型（P2V 与 IaaS）】
执行物理机到虚拟机（P2V）转换并托管在基础设施即服务（IaaS）上，可以立即淘汰本地物理服务器硬件，同时无需重写代码即可让旧版应用在最后一年继续原样运行。主机托管（Colocation）仍需保留物理硬件；平台即服务（PaaS）需要对老旧应用进行重构；备份后关机则会导致应用无法在最后一年继续使用。
explanation.en: Performing a physical-to-virtual (P2V) conversion and hosting the virtual machine on Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) allows the company to immediately decommission its physical server hardware while keeping the legacy application running unmodified for its final year. Colocation still requires maintaining physical servers, PaaS would require refactoring the legacy application, and shutting down the server after a backup would make the application unavailable.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：淘汰物理留旧软，P2V 迁上 IaaS 最划算。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Decommission physical hardware + keep legacy app running as-is = P2V onto IaaS.

stem.zh: 技术人员正在为一台使用了十年的电脑更换故障电源。在安装客户提供的电源时，技术人员发现 ATX 连接器无法插入主板。客户希望采用一种高性价比的解决方案。技术人员接下来应该怎么做？
stem.en: A technician is replacing a failed power supply in a ten-year-old computer When installing the customerprovided power supply, the technician discovers the ATX connector would not plug into the motherboard. The customer wants a cost-effective solution. Which of the following should the technician do next?

explanation.zh:
【考点：电源接口兼容性（ATX 20-pin 与 24-pin）】
老旧主板通常使用 20-pin 的 ATX 主供电接口，而新款电源配备的是 24-pin 接口。当客户提供的电源无法直接插入旧主板且追求高性价比时，使用 20-pin 转 24-pin 转接头（Adapter）是最直接、经济的解决方案。调节输入电压与接口针脚无关；购买全模组电源成本高且不解决旧主板针脚数问题；拆修故障电源既危险又不划算。
explanation.en: Legacy motherboards from older systems often use a 20-pin main ATX power header, whereas modern power supplies feature a 24-pin ATX connector. If the 24-pin connector does not have a detachable 4-pin section, using a 20-pin to 24-pin adapter is the most cost-effective way to connect the new PSU to the older motherboard. Adjusting input voltage, buying another modular PSU, or rebuilding a failed power supply are either irrelevant, unnecessary, or unsafe.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：老主板新电源插不上，20 转 24 针转接头最省钱。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: New 24-pin PSU on an old 20-pin motherboard = use a 20-pin to 24-pin adapter.

stem.zh: 某用户的笔记本电脑在启动时出现间歇性故障。技术人员发现用户一直插着公司闪存盘（U 盘），从而导致了该问题。技术人员应该配置以下哪项？
stem.en: A user's laptop experiences intermittent issues during startup. A technician finds that the user has left a corporate flash drive plugged in, which is causing the issues. Which of the following should the technician configure?

explanation.zh:
【考点：BIOS/UEFI 启动顺序配置（Boot Options）】
当笔记本插着 U 盘开机出现间歇性启动异常时，是因为 BIOS/UEFI 的启动顺序（Boot order）将外部 USB 设备排在了内置硬盘之前，导致系统尝试从 U 盘引导。在 BIOS/UEFI 中调整启动选项（Boot options），将内置硬盘设为第一启动项即可彻底解决。BitLocker 和 TPM 涉及磁盘加密与安全芯片，而禁用整个 USB 功能会影响正常外设使用。
explanation.en: When a USB flash drive is left plugged in during startup, the system BIOS/UEFI may attempt to boot from the external USB drive before the internal storage drive if USB is prioritized in the boot order. Configuring the boot options (boot sequence/priority) in BIOS/UEFI so the internal OS drive boots first prevents connected flash drives from interrupting startup. BitLocker and TPM manage encryption and hardware security keys, while disabling USB ports entirely would unnecessarily block peripheral use.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：插着 U 盘难开机，进 BIOS 改 Boot 启动顺序。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Startup fails when a USB drive is plugged in = change Boot options/boot order in BIOS/UEFI.

stem.zh: 技术人员会使用以下哪种工具将线芯连接到 RJ45 连接器？
stem.en: Which of the following tools would a technician use to connect wires to an RJ45 connector?

explanation.zh:
【考点：网线制作工具（压线钳 Crimper）】
压线钳（Crimper）专门用于将双绞线压接到 RJ45 水晶头（连接器）中，使金属簧片刺破线芯绝缘层建立电气连接。剥线钳（Cable stripper）用于剥除网线外皮；打线刀（Punchdown）用于将线芯打入配线架或信息模块（Keystone jack）；环回插头（Loopback plug）用于测试网卡接口。
explanation.en: A crimper is used to terminate network cables by pressing the metal contacts inside an RJ45 modular connector onto the individual copper wires and securing the plug to the cable jacket. A cable stripper removes the outer insulation jacket, a punchdown tool seats wires into IDC blocks on patch panels or keystone jacks, and a loopback plug is used for testing port functionality.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：水晶头用压线钳（Crimper），模块配线架用打线刀（Punchdown）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Attaching an RJ45 plug = Crimper; wiring a patch panel or keystone jack = Punchdown tool.

stem.zh: 管理员正在配置一个 SOHO 网络。该网络范围要求为打印机分配静态 IP 地址。管理员必须手动设置以下哪些项？（选两项）
stem.en: An administrator is configuring a SOHO network. The network scope requires static IP addresses for printers. Which of the following must the administrator set manually? (Select two.)

explanation.zh:
【考点：静态 IP 地址手动配置要素】
为打印机配置静态 IP 地址时，管理员必须在设备上手动设置 IP 地址、子网掩码（Subnet mask，用于界定本地子网范围）和默认网关（Default gateway，用于跨网段通信）。DHCP 开关、保留地址（Reservations）和排除范围（Exclusions）均属于 DHCP 服务器端的配置概念，而非静态 IP 客户端必填参数。
explanation.en: When manually configuring a static IP address on a printer or host, the administrator must manually configure the IP address, subnet mask (to define the local network boundary), and default gateway (to enable communication across subnets). DHCP, reservations, and exclusions are configured on the DHCP server rather than manually entered into the client's static IP settings.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：静态 IP 手动填三宝：IP、子网掩码（Subnet mask）和默认网关（Default gateway）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Manual static IP configuration always requires IP address, Subnet mask, and Default gateway.

stem.zh: 一家当地银行正在设计其新的基础设施蓝图。以下哪种 RAID 类型提供双奇偶校验（Double parity）？
stem.en: A local bank is designing its new infrastructure blueprint. Which of the following RAID types offers double parity?

explanation.zh:
【考点：RAID 级别与容错机制（RAID 6 双奇偶校验）】
RAID 6 采用带双重分布式奇偶校验（Double parity）的条带化技术，允许阵列中同时损坏任意两块硬盘而不丢失数据，非常适合银行等高可用场景。RAID 0 仅条带化无冗余；RAID 1 采用镜像（Mirroring）而非奇偶校验；RAID 5 仅提供单奇偶校验（Single parity），只能容忍一块硬盘故障。
explanation.en: RAID 6 uses block-level striping with double distributed parity across at least four drives, allowing the array to withstand the simultaneous failure of any two disks without losing data. RAID 0 offers striping only with zero redundancy, RAID 1 uses disk mirroring without parity, and RAID 5 provides only single distributed parity (tolerating just one drive failure).

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：RAID 5 单校验坏一块，RAID 6 双校验（Double parity）抗两块。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Single parity = RAID 5 (1 drive failure); Double parity = RAID 6 (2 drive failures).

stem.zh: 经理希望确保员工只能取走自己的打印件。以下哪些项可以实现这一目标？（选两项）
stem.en: A manager wants to ensure that employees can only pick up their own printouts. Which of the following accomplishes this objective? Select two.

explanation.zh:
【考点：打印机安全释放（Secure Print / Badge & PIN）】
为了确保员工只能取走自己的打印件，需启用安全打印释放（Secure print）机制，将打印任务暂存在队列中，直到本人在打印机前完成身份验证后才出纸。输入用户 PIN 码（User PIN）或刷员工 RFID 工卡（RFID badge）均可在打印机端验证身份并释放个人打印任务。PCL 是打印语言，纸盒选择、双面打印（Duplex）和 USB 均无法实现身份验证防冒领。
explanation.en: Secure print release prevents sensitive documents from sitting unattended in the printer output tray by holding jobs in the queue until the user authenticates at the printer. Requiring a User PIN entered on the printer's keypad or tapping an employee RFID badge at the printer ensures only the authorized owner can release and pick up their printouts. PCL is a page description language, while tray selection, duplexing, and USB do not enforce user authentication at pickup.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：打印防代领用安全释放，输 User PIN 或刷 RFID 卡当场取。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Secure print release at the printer = User PIN or RFID badge authentication.

stem.zh: 某用户去办公室时忘带笔记本电脑充电器。借用一个充电器后，用户发现电池充电很慢。为了让电池正常充电，技术人员首先应该采取以下哪个步骤？
stem.en: A user goes to their office and forgets their laptop charger. After borrowing a charger, the user notices that the battery is charging slowly. Which of the following steps should a technician take first to charge the battery normally?

explanation.zh:
【考点：笔记本电源适配器功率故障排查】
借用他人充电器后立即出现充电缓慢，最常见的原因是借来的电源适配器输出功率（瓦数/电流）不足或规格不完全匹配。排错第一步应更换为符合该机型额定功率的电源适配器（Power supply）。在确认外接电源功率合规之前，调整电池性能设置、换端口或直接更换内置电池都不是首选步骤。
explanation.en: When a laptop charges slowly immediately after plugging in a borrowed AC adapter, the borrowed charger is likely underpowered (insufficient wattage/amperage) for that specific laptop model. The technician should first test with a known-good, properly rated power supply designed for the laptop. Adjusting OS power settings, switching ports, or replacing the internal battery are unnecessary before verifying the external power adapter's wattage rating.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：借用充电器充电慢，多半瓦数不够先换合规电源（Power supply）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Slow charging with a borrowed charger = underpowered wattage; swap to the correct power supply first.

stem.zh: 客户反映一份纯文本文档打印出来是无法识别的乱码字符，但打印预览能正确显示该文档。以下哪项最可能是导致该问题的原因？
stem.en: A customer reports that a text-only document prints with unrecognizable characters. The print preview correctly displays the document. Which of the following is the most likely cause of the issue?

explanation.zh:
【考点：打印机乱码故障（驱动程序错误 Incorrect Driver）】
打印预览正常但打出来的全是无法识别的乱码字符（Garbled characters），最典型原因是安装了错误或损坏的打印机驱动程序（Incorrect driver），导致发送给打印机的页面描述语言（如 PCL 与 PostScript）不匹配。如果文档本身损坏，打印预览也会异常；硒鼓故障会导致字迹变浅或条纹等物理瑕疵而非字符乱码；固件过时极少导致纯文本编码错乱。
explanation.en: Printing garbled or unrecognizable characters when the document looks normal in print preview is a classic symptom of an incorrect or corrupted printer driver sending the wrong page description language (such as PostScript instead of PCL) to the printer. A corrupted document file would also look wrong in print preview, a bad toner cartridge causes physical print defects like streaks or faded text rather than wrong character encoding, and firmware rarely alters standard text translation.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：预览正常打印出乱码，必选驱动错误（Incorrect driver）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Garbled or unrecognizable characters on printout = Incorrect or corrupted printer driver.

stem.zh: 蓝牙（Bluetooth）网络属于以下哪种网络的示例？
stem.en: Which of the following is a Bluetooth network an example of?

explanation.zh:
【考点：网络地理范围分类（个人局域网 PAN）】
蓝牙（Bluetooth）是一种用于短距离（通常几米内）连接手机、耳机、键盘、鼠标和智能穿戴设备的无线技术，是个人区域网（PAN，Personal Area Network）的典型代表。LAN（局域网）覆盖房间或楼宇，WAN（广域网）跨越城市或全球，SAN（存储区域网）则是专用高速存储网络。
explanation.en: Bluetooth is a short-range wireless technology designed to connect personal peripherals—such as headsets, mice, keyboards, and smartwatches—to a smartphone or computer over a few meters, which defines a Personal Area Network (PAN). LANs cover local buildings or offices, WANs span large geographic areas, and SANs are high-speed dedicated storage networks.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：蓝牙短距连外设，属于个人局域网（PAN）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Bluetooth and short-range personal device connections = PAN (Personal Area Network).

stem.zh: 部分用户无法正常使用其工作站联网。管理员在其中一台工作站上运行了 `ipconfig` 并查看了配置，随后运行测试命令并收到了超时输出。以下哪项是导致该问题的根源？
stem.en: Some users are unable to access their workstations. An administrator runs ipconfig on one of the workstations and sees the following: The administrator runs the following command and receives this output: Which of the following is the source of issue?

explanation.zh:
【考点：网络连接故障排查（默认网关/路由器故障）】
工作站通过 `ipconfig` 显示已获取到合法的私有 IP 地址、子网掩码和默认网关（非 169.254.x.x 的 APIPA 地址），说明 DHCP 服务正常；但对默认网关执行 `ping` 命令却超时，说明作为默认网关的路由器（Router）宕机、断电或接口断开，导致无法访问外部网络。DNS 故障仅影响域名解析而不影响 IP 连通性，Web 服务器故障不会导致网关无法 ping 通。
explanation.en: When a workstation has a valid IPv4 address, subnet mask, and default gateway from DHCP, DHCP is working properly; however, if pinging the default gateway IP times out, the local router (default gateway) is unreachable or down. A DNS failure would only prevent hostname resolution while IP pings still succeed, and a web server issue would not block local gateway connectivity.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：IP 正常但 Ping 不通默认网关，故障源头在路由器（Router）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Valid DHCP IP + cannot ping default gateway = Router is down or unreachable.

stem.zh: 以下哪项是一种隔离的虚拟机环境？
stem.en: Which of the following is an isolated virtual machine?

explanation.zh:
【考点：虚拟化安全环境（沙箱 Sandbox）】
沙箱（Sandbox）是一种与主系统及生产网络完全隔离的虚拟机或受限执行环境，专门用于安全地测试未知代码、可疑恶意软件或未验证的软件更新，防止影响宿主机。Hypervisor 是创建和管理虚拟机的虚拟化管理程序；容器（Container）是共享宿主机内核的轻量级应用封装；VDI 是虚拟桌面基础设施。
explanation.en: A sandbox is an isolated virtual machine or restricted testing environment used to safely execute untrusted code, malware samples, or experimental software changes without risking harm to the host operating system or production network. A hypervisor is the software layer that creates and runs VMs, a container packages application code with shared OS kernel dependencies, and VDI hosts desktop operating systems on a centralized server.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：隔离环境测代码防中毒，独立虚拟机叫沙箱（Sandbox）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Isolated VM environment for safe software/malware testing = Sandbox.

stem.zh: 为了确保屏幕图像显示效果与打印输出一致，以下哪项显示器特性最重要？
stem.en: Which of the following display characteristics would be most important to ensure screen images appear the same as printed output?

explanation.zh:
【考点：显示器参数指标（色域 Color Gamut）】
色域（Color gamut）是指显示器能够准确还原的颜色范围，对于平面设计和印刷排版至关重要，广色域且色彩精准的显示器能确保屏幕显示效果与实际打印输出（CMYK）保持一致。像素密度（Pixel density）和分辨率（Resolution）决定图像清晰度与细腻度，刷新率（Refresh rate）决定动态画面流畅度，均与色彩还原准确性无关。
explanation.en: Color gamut defines the range and accuracy of colors a monitor can reproduce, which is critical for graphic design and print production so on-screen colors match physical printed output. Pixel density and resolution determine image sharpness and detail, while refresh rate controls motion smoothness.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：屏幕颜色对准打印稿，色彩还原看色域（Color gamut）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Matching screen colors to printed output = Color gamut.

stem.zh: 某用户经常需要在笔记本电脑上连接和断开多个外设。为了方便用户移动办公，技术人员应该推荐以下哪个选项？
stem.en: A user routinely connects and disconnects multiple devices from a laptop. Which of the following options should a technician recommend to facilitate ease of user mobility?

explanation.zh:
【考点：笔记本扩展配件（扩展坞 Docking Station）】
扩展坞（Docking station）为笔记本电脑提供一站式集中接口（涵盖外接显示器、有线网络、键鼠外设及供电），让经常移动办公的用户只需拔插一次即可快速连接或断开所有桌面外设。USB 集线器（USB hub）仅扩展 USB 接口，缺乏完整的多屏视频与原装供电能力；网络交换机用于局域网多机互联；串口（Serial）是过时的老旧单设备接口。
explanation.en: A docking station allows a mobile laptop user to connect or disconnect multiple desktop peripherals—including external monitors, full-sized keyboards, mice, Ethernet, and power—through a single connection or dock mechanism. A USB hub only adds basic USB ports without full enterprise video/power docking capabilities, a network switch connects multiple hosts to a LAN, and serial interfaces are legacy single-device ports.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：笔记本外设频繁拔插要便携，首选扩展坞（Docking station）一线通。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Frequent laptop connect/disconnect of multiple peripherals for mobility = Docking station.

stem.zh: 某用户打开笔记本电脑，键盘灯亮起，但即使重启后屏幕依然黑屏。技术人员接下来应该采取以下哪项措施来排查该问题？
stem.en: A user turns on their laptop. The keyboard lights up, but the screen is black even after the user restarts the laptop. Which of the following should a technician do next to troubleshoot the issue?

options.text: Connect the laptop to an external monitor.

explanation.zh:
【考点：笔记本显示故障排查（外接显示器隔离法）】
键盘背光亮起说明笔记本已正常通电开机，此时黑屏可能是内置液晶屏/背光故障、屏线松动或主板显卡问题。下一步最佳排错操作是连接外接显示器（External monitor）：若外接屏显示正常，即可快速锁定为笔记本内屏或屏线故障；若外接屏也无信号，则是主板/GPU 故障。在未做外接排查前，直接拆屏幕边框（Bezel）或换电脑过于激进。
explanation.en: Because the keyboard backlight illuminates, the laptop is receiving power and turning on, so connecting an external monitor is the fastest way to isolate whether the issue lies with the internal LCD panel/backlight/cable or the motherboard's GPU. Removing the bezel or replacing the laptop is invasive and premature before external isolation, and plugging in a charger is unnecessary when the system clearly powers on.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：开机键亮屏幕黑，先接外接显示器（External monitor）排显卡。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Laptop powers on (lights/fans) with a black screen = connect an external monitor first to isolate GPU vs. LCD.

stem.zh: 客户反映其平板电脑最近摔到了地上。平板电脑显示屏一角有一道小裂纹，且插上电源后无法充电。技术人员首先应该怎么做？
stem.en: A customer reports their tablet was recently dropped on the ground. The tablet has a small crack in one corner of the display, and it does not charge when plugged in. Which of the following should a technician do first?

options.text: Inspect the USB-C port for damage

explanation.zh:
【考点：移动设备跌落与不充电故障排查】
平板电脑摔落地面后角落有裂痕且插电无法充电，首先应进行外观物理检查，查看 USB-C 充电端口（USB-C port）是否有针脚变形、松动损坏或异物堵塞。在未确认外部充电接口完好之前，直接拆机换电池、测试触摸数字化仪（Digitizer）或强制重启都不是针对不充电故障的首要步骤。
explanation.en: After a physical drop that causes visible casing or corner damage and prevents charging, the technician should first visually inspect the USB-C charging port for bent pins, cracked solder joints, or debris. Replacing the internal battery, running digitizer touch diagnostics, or forcing a hard restart will not resolve a physically damaged charging connector.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：平板摔后充不上电，第一步先查 USB-C 充电口物理损伤。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Dropped tablet/phone won't charge = inspect the charging port (USB-C) for physical damage first.

stem.zh: 技术人员必须在公司办公室安装一台供所有员工使用的打印机。以下哪项是最佳选择？
stem.en: A technician must install a printer at a corporate office for all employees to use. Which of the following is the best option?

explanation.zh:
【考点：企业级共享打印部署（打印服务器 Print Server）】
在供全体员工共同使用的企业办公环境中，部署打印服务器（Print server）是最佳选择，它能集中管理打印队列、自动分发驱动程序并提供权限与审计控制。蓝牙（Bluetooth）和 Wi-Fi Direct 属于短距离点对点连接，不适合多用户高并发企业办公；云打印依赖外部互联网，不如本地打印服务器稳定高可控。
explanation.en: In a corporate office where all employees need reliable shared access to a printer, deploying a print server is the best solution because it centralizes print queues, automates driver distribution, and enforces enterprise access controls. Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct are short-range peer-to-peer connection methods unsuitable for large office groups, and cloud printing relies on external internet connectivity rather than local enterprise queue management.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：公司全员共享打印机，集中队列管理选打印服务器（Print server）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Shared printer for all employees in a corporate office = Print server.

stem.zh: 以下哪种云模型完全使用本地数据中心？
stem.en: Which of the following cloud models exclusively utilizes a local data center?

explanation.zh:
【考点：云部署模型（私有云 Private Cloud）】
私有云（Private cloud）专为单一组织构建和独占使用，通常完全部署在企业自己的本地数据中心（Local data center / On-premises）内，以实现对数据安全和合规性的完全控制。公有云（Public）由第三方云商托管并多租户共享；混合云（Hybrid）结合了私有云与公有云；社区云（Community）由多个有共同诉求的机构联合共享。
explanation.en: A private cloud model is dedicated to a single organization and is often hosted exclusively inside the company's own local on-premises data center to maximize control over security and compliance. Public clouds are hosted off-site by third-party providers for multiple tenants, hybrid clouds combine local private and external public cloud resources, and community clouds are shared among multiple organizations with common regulatory needs.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：独占本地数据中心不外联，必选私有云（Private cloud）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Cloud model hosted exclusively in a local/on-premises data center for one company = Private cloud.

stem.zh: 用户的手机对触摸没有响应。技术人员检查了手机，但没有发现任何物理损坏的迹象。技术人员重启了设备，但未能解决该问题。技术人员接下来最应该检查以下哪个组件？
stem.en: A user's phone does not respond to touch. A technician inspects the phone but does not see any evidence of physical damage. The technician restarts the device, which does not fix the issue. Which of the following components should the technician examine next?

explanation.zh:
【考点：移动设备触摸屏与数字化仪（Digitizer）故障排查】
数字化仪（Digitizer）是覆盖在显示屏上的触控感应组件，负责将物理触摸转化为数字信号。当屏幕外观完好且重启无效、但完全无法响应触摸时，最可能是数字化仪发生故障。电池（Battery）负责供电；屏幕（Screen）仅负责画面显示；手写笔（Stylus）是外部配件，均不是导致手指触控完全失灵的内部核心组件。
explanation.en: The digitizer is the touch-sensing component layered over the display that translates physical touch into digital input. If the screen shows no physical damage and a restart does not resolve the unresponsive touchscreen, the digitizer is the most likely failed component. The battery powers the device, the screen (LCD/OLED) only displays images, and a stylus is an external accessory rather than the internal sensor responsible for finger touch.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：有画面无触控，重启无效查数字化仪（Digitizer）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Screen displays fine but touch doesn't work = faulty digitizer.

stem.zh: 以下哪项是最可能的原因？
stem.en: Which of the following is the most likely cause?

explanation.zh:
【考点：DNS 手动配置与网络名称解析故障】
在企业网络中，通过 DHCP 获取 IP 地址的设备通常也会自动获取内部 DNS 服务器地址。如果 `ipconfig` 输出显示 DNS 服务器与 DHCP 分配的内部网段不符（例如被设置为公共 DNS），说明客户端上手动设置了 DNS 服务器，这会导致无法解析内网主机名或引发访问异常。启用 DHCP 或 NetBIOS 属于正常配置，而子网掩码错误影响的是本地网段路由而非 DNS 条目异常。
explanation.en: When a device receives its IP address via DHCP in a corporate environment, it typically receives internal DNS server addresses automatically as well. If the DNS servers are pointing to external public addresses (such as 8.8.8.8) or do not match the DHCP-assigned settings, the DNS servers were manually configured on the client, which can prevent resolution of internal network resources. DHCP being enabled is normal, and an incorrect subnet mask or NetBIOS configuration would not explain mismatched DNS server entries.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：DHCP 自动配却见外部 DNS，定是手动改了 DNS 设置。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: DHCP enabled + unexpected/public DNS addresses in ipconfig = DNS servers manually set.

stem.zh: 用户抱怨演讲者的音频断断续续且听不清楚。以下哪项是导致该问题的原因？
stem.en: Users are complaining that the audio from a presenter is choppy and unintelligible Which of the following is causing the issue?

explanation.zh:
【考点：音频输入设备（麦克风）故障排查】
演讲者的声音断断续续、模糊不清，问题出在负责采集声音的音频输入设备——麦克风（Microphone）上（如硬件缺陷、连接松动或配置不当）。网络摄像头（Webcam）负责采集视频画面；数字化仪（Digitizer）用于处理屏幕触摸输入；逆变器（Inverter）用于为旧式 LCD 背光灯供电，均与音频采集无关。
explanation.en: Choppy, garbled, or unintelligible audio from a presenter is caused by an issue with the audio input device, which is the microphone (such as loose connections, hardware failure, or poor input configuration). A webcam captures video rather than audio, a digitizer processes touch input on a screen, and an inverter supplies power to older LCD backlights.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：发言声音断续听不清，采集端找麦克风（Microphone）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Choppy or unintelligible presenter voice = faulty microphone.

stem.zh: 一台台式机可以连接到文件服务器，但无法访问互联网。`ipconfig /all` 输出显示 IP 和 DNS 正确，但没有默认网关（Default gateway）。以下哪项最可能恢复互联网访问？
stem.en: A desktop can connect to a file server but cannot access the internet. The ipconfig /all output shows a correct IP and DNS but no default gateway. What will most likely restore internet access?

explanation.zh:
【考点：默认网关（Default Gateway）与跨网段通信】
默认网关（Default gateway）是设备访问本地子网以外网络（如互联网）的必经路由器出口。缺少默认网关时，台式机仍可与同一局域网内的文件服务器正常通信，但无法将数据包路由到外网。由于 IP 和 DNS 均正常，刷新 DNS 缓存、更改 IPv6 地址或禁用 NetBIOS 都无法解决缺少外网路由出口的问题。
explanation.en: The default gateway is the router IP address required for a host to send traffic outside its local subnet, such as to the internet. Without a default gateway, the desktop can still communicate with devices on the local LAN (like the local file server) but cannot route traffic to external networks. Flushing the DNS cache, changing the IPv6 address, or disabling NetBIOS will not restore external IPv4 routing when the gateway is missing.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：内网通外网断，ipconfig 缺网关，补上默认网关即复原。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Can reach local LAN but no internet + missing gateway in ipconfig = set the default gateway.

stem.zh: 某客户拥有运行 Windows、Linux 和 Unix 的裸机服务器。他们希望在保持隔离性和兼容性的同时进行服务器整合。技术人员应该推荐以下哪项？
stem.en: A customer has bare-metal servers running Windows, Linux, and Unix. They want consolidation while maintaining isolation and compatibility. What should the technician recommend?

explanation.zh:
【考点：云服务模型 IaaS 与多操作系统服务器整合】
基础设施即服务（IaaS）提供底层虚拟化计算资源（CPU、内存、存储和网络），允许将多台运行不同操作系统（Windows、Linux 和 Unix）的裸机服务器整合为彼此完全隔离且兼容的独立虚拟机。容器（Containers）共享宿主机操作系统内核，无法在同一内核上直接混跑不同家族的操作系统；Type 2 虚拟机监控程序运行在宿主桌面系统之上，不适合企业级裸机整合；VDI 则用于终端虚拟桌面而非服务器整合。
explanation.en: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) provides virtualized computing hardware (CPU, RAM, storage, and networking) in the cloud, allowing an organization to consolidate physical servers into isolated virtual machines running completely different operating systems (Windows, Linux, and Unix). Containers share the host OS kernel and cannot mix incompatible OS kernels on one host, a Type 2 hypervisor runs atop a desktop host OS rather than enterprise bare-metal consolidation, and VDI is designed for end-user desktops rather than multi-OS server consolidation.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：多系统（Win/Linux/Unix）裸机整合求隔离，首选云端 IaaS。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Consolidating multiple OS families (Windows/Linux/Unix) with full isolation = IaaS.

stem.zh: 以下哪种驱动器接口通常用于服务器系统，而不用于家用电脑？
stem.en: Which of the following drive interfaces is typically used in server systems but not in home computers?

explanation.zh:
【考点：存储驱动器接口（SAS vs. 消费级接口）】
SAS（串行连接 SCSI）是一种专为企业级服务器设计的高性能、高可靠性驱动器接口，支持全双工传输与高负载持续运行，需要专用的 SAS 控制器，因此通常用于服务器而不会出现在家用电脑中。NVMe、SATA 和 PCIe 则广泛普及于普通家用台式机和笔记本电脑中。
explanation.en: SAS (Serial Attached SCSI) is an enterprise-grade storage interface designed for high reliability, continuous heavy workloads, and high-speed performance in server environments, and requires specialized controller hardware rarely found in home PCs. NVMe, SATA, and PCIe are all widely used in consumer desktop and laptop computers as well as servers.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：家用电脑用 SATA/NVMe，企业服务器专用选 SAS。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Enterprise server-only drive interface = SAS (Serial Attached SCSI).

stem.zh: 一名技术人员正在检修一台几年前组装的高端游戏电脑。客户反映该系统刚开始能正常工作一小段时间，但随后运行变慢，直到最后死机并自动关机。技术人员首先应该检查以下哪项？
stem.en: A technician is working on a high-end gaming computer that was built several years ago. The customer reports that the system will work OK for a short time, but then the system performs slowly until it finally locks up and turns off. Which of the following should the technician check first?

options.text: Voltage input and output from the power supply
Fan speed and airflow through the heat sinks
Memory channel configuration and CAS timings

explanation.zh:
【考点：PC 过热降频与自动关机故障排查】
电脑开机初期运行正常，随后逐渐变慢（过热降频），最终死机并自动断电，这是典型的硬件过热保护症状。对于使用了几年的高端游戏电脑，灰尘堵塞散热片或风扇转速异常是最常见的原因，因此首先应检查风扇转速和散热器气流。电源电压问题、内存通道时序或机械硬盘文件碎片均不会表现为随运行时间升温而降频关机的典型规律。
explanation.en: A computer that runs normally at first, gradually slows down (thermal throttling), and then locks up and shuts down is exhibiting classic symptoms of overheating. On an older gaming PC, dust buildup in heat sinks or failing cooling fans are the primary culprits, so checking fan speed and airflow through the heat sinks is the best first step. Power supply voltage issues, RAM timings, or HDD fragmentation would not cause a predictable thermal buildup pattern followed by a protective shutdown.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：先正常后变慢再死机断电，典型过热先查风扇与散热片。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Works fine at first, slows down, then locks up and powers off = overheating (check fans and heat sinks).

stem.zh: 用户的 PC 中有两块容量相同的 SSD。用户希望将这两块 SSD 配置为保存所有数据的副本，以便在其中一块驱动器发生故障时不会丢失数据。这是以下哪项的示例？
stem.en: A user has two SSDs of the same size in their PC. The user wants to configure both SSDs to have a copy of all data so there will be no data loss if one drive fails. Which of the following is this an example of?

explanation.zh:
【考点：RAID 级别（RAID 1 磁盘镜像）】
RAID 1（镜像）会将相同的数据同时写入两块容量相同的硬盘，使两块 SSD 保存完全一致的数据副本；当其中一块硬盘损坏时，系统不会丢失任何数据。RAID 0 仅条带化无冗余，坏一块盘数据全丢；RAID 5 至少需要 3 块硬盘；RAID 10 至少需要 4 块硬盘。
explanation.en: RAID 1 (mirroring) writes identical copies of data to two drives simultaneously so that if one drive fails, no data is lost. RAID 0 (striping) offers no fault tolerance and loses all data if a drive fails. RAID 5 requires at least three drives, and RAID 10 requires at least four drives.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：两块硬盘存镜像、坏一不丢数，必选 RAID 1。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: 2 drives + exact copy of data for fault tolerance = RAID 1 (mirroring).

stem.zh: 一名技术人员正在测试网络配置，并将两台笔记本电脑连接到一台非网管型交换机上。技术人员将其中一台笔记本电脑配置为静态 IP 地址 `192.168.1.1`，另一台配置为静态 IP 地址 `192.168.2.2`。两台笔记本电脑无法相互通信。以下哪项是该问题最可能的解释？
stem.en: A technician is experimenting with network configurations and has connected two laptops to an unmanaged switch. The technician configured one of the laptops with a static IP address of 192.168.1.1 and the other with a static IP address of 192.168.2.2. The laptops are not communicating with each other. Which of the following is the most likely explanation for this issue?

options.text: The technician needs to use a hub instead of a switch.
The laptops do not have access to a router.

explanation.zh:
【考点：跨子网通信与路由器（Layer 3）的作用】
在默认的 C 类子网掩码（`255.255.255.0`）下，`192.168.1.1` 和 `192.168.2.2` 处于两个不同的子网中。非网管型二层交换机只能转发同一子网内部的数据帧，不同子网之间的通信必须借助三层设备（路由器 Router）进行路由转发。换成集线器（Hub）、排查无线网卡或归咎于 PoE 均无法解决跨网段无路由的问题。
explanation.en: Assuming a standard `/24` (`255.255.255.0`) subnet mask for Class C private addresses, `192.168.1.1` and `192.168.2.2` belong to two different subnets (`192.168.1.0/24` and `192.168.2.0/24`). An unmanaged Layer 2 switch only forwards traffic within the same subnet; a Layer 3 device such as a router is required to route traffic between different subnets. Using a hub, checking wireless NICs on a wired switch connection, or blaming PoE will not enable inter-subnet routing.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：二层交换机连不同网段（1.x 与 2.x），不通是因为缺路由器。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Two devices on different subnets (192.168.1.x vs 192.168.2.x) on a Layer 2 switch need a router to communicate.

stem.zh: 在光纤网络线缆上可以找到以下哪种连接器？
stem.en: Which of the following connectors is found on an optical networking cable?

explanation.zh:
【考点：光纤网络接口类型（LC 连接器）】
LC（Lucent Connector）是光纤网络线缆上常用的小型化光纤连接器，广泛应用于高速光模块和光纤跳线。RJ45 用于双绞线铜缆以太网；USB-C 是通用外设充电与数据传输接口；Lightning 是苹果专用的移动设备接口，后三者均不属于光纤连接器。
explanation.en: The LC (Lucent Connector) is a small form-factor fiber-optic connector commonly used to terminate optical networking cables. RJ45 is used on twisted-pair copper Ethernet cables, while USB-C and Lightning are peripheral and mobile device connectors for power and copper data transfer.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：光纤接头认准 LC / SC / ST，RJ45 是铜缆网线。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Fiber-optic cable connectors = LC, SC, ST, MTRJ (Copper Ethernet = RJ45).

stem.zh: 某用户报告打印时出现问题。每次用户发送打印任务时，打印机都会连续打印出包含随机字符的纸张，但没有污迹或打印质量问题。技术人员应该执行以下哪项操作来解决此问题？
stem.en: A user reports problems when printing. Every time the user sends a print job, the printer produces continuous pages of random characters. There are no smudging or print-quality issues. Which of the following should the technician do to resolve the issue?

explanation.zh:
【考点：打印机连续打印乱码故障排查】
打印机源源不断地打印出随机乱码字符，但字迹清晰无污迹，通常是因为计算机安装了错误或损坏的打印机驱动程序（发送了打印机无法正确解析的 PCL 或 PostScript 指令数据）。重新安装正确的打印机驱动程序即可恢复正常解析。调整 DPI 分辨率、更换碳粉盒（Toner）或更新固件均不是解决驱动指令不匹配的正确方法。
explanation.en: Continuous pages of random or garbled characters indicate that the computer is sending print jobs using an incorrect or corrupted page description language (such as the wrong PCL or PostScript driver) that the printer cannot interpret properly. Reinstalling the correct printer driver software resolves this translation mismatch. Adjusting DPI, replacing toner, or updating firmware will not fix corrupted or mismatched driver output.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：打印连续乱码字迹清，驱动损坏或不配，重装驱动即刻灵。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Printer spits out continuous pages of random/garbled characters = wrong or corrupt printer driver (reinstall driver).

stem.zh: 以下哪种连接器可将新的 ISP 有线宽带调制解调器（Cable modem）上联到其墙面插座？
stem.en: Which of the following connectors will uplink a new ISP cable modem to its wall jack?

explanation.zh:
【考点：有线电视宽带调制解调器（Cable Modem）物理接口】
ISP 的有线宽带调制解调器（Cable modem）通过同轴电缆（Coaxial cable）连接到墙面插座，同轴电缆标准配备带螺纹的 F 型（F-type）连接器。LC 用于光纤连接；RJ45 用于以太网双绞线（连接调制解调器与路由器或电脑）；Lightning 用于苹果移动设备。
explanation.en: A cable modem connects to the ISP's coaxial wall jack using a coaxial cable terminated with threaded F-type connectors. LC connectors are used for fiber-optic cables, RJ45 connectors are used on Ethernet cables to connect the modem's LAN port to a router or PC, and Lightning connectors are used on Apple mobile devices.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：Cable 猫连墙面同轴口，螺纹接头选 F-type。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Cable modem to coaxial wall jack = F-type connector.

stem.zh: 一名用户出差归来后发现连接到局域网（LAN）的电脑间歇性超时。经调查，技术人员发现 RJ45 针脚未正确端接。以下哪种网络工具最适合修复该问题？
stem.en: A user returns from a trip and discovers a computer that is connected to the LAN times out intermittently Upon investigation, a technician finds the RJ45 pin is not property terminated Which of the following networking tools is most appropriate to fix the issue?

explanation.zh:
【考点：网络布线工具（压线钳 Crimper）】
压线钳（Crimper）专门用于将水晶头（RJ45 连接器）的金属针脚压入双绞线铜芯中，从而修复端接不良的 RJ45 接头。寻线仪（Toner probe）用于追踪线缆位置；测线仪（Cable tester）仅能检测连通性而无法修复物理接头；打线刀（Punchdown tool）用于将线缆打入配线架或信息模块（Keystone jack），而非压制 RJ45 水晶头。
explanation.en: A crimper is the networking tool used to firmly press the metal pins of an RJ45 connector into the copper wires of a twisted-pair Ethernet cable, fixing an improperly terminated RJ45 plug. A toner probe traces cables, a cable tester only diagnoses wiring faults without repairing them, and a punchdown tool terminates wires into keystone jacks or patch panels rather than RJ45 plugs.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：水晶头（RJ45）端接不良用压线钳（Crimper），模块配线架用打线刀（Punchdown）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Terminate or fix an RJ45 connector on a cable = Crimper; terminate wires into a patch panel/jack = Punchdown tool.

stem.zh: 一名技术人员组装了一台新电脑。在首次启动时，电脑通过了开机自检（POST），但无法启动操作系统。以下哪个组件发生了故障？
stem.en: A technician has built a new computer. On the initial startup, the computer passes POST but will not turn on the operating system. Which of the following components has failed?

explanation.zh:
【考点：开机自检（POST）通过但无法引导操作系统的故障排查】
新装电脑顺利通过开机自检（POST），说明电源（Power supply）、CPU、主板和内存等核心硬件均工作正常。POST 之后无法加载操作系统，说明 BIOS/UEFI 无法从存储设备读取引导程序，最可能是承载操作系统的机械硬盘（HDD）发生故障或未正确连接。声卡（Audio card）不影响系统启动，而 CPU 或电源故障会导致根本无法通过 POST。
explanation.en: When a computer passes the Power-On Self-Test (POST), core hardware such as the power supply, CPU, motherboard, and RAM are functioning properly, and the system is ready to hand off control to a bootable storage drive. If the operating system fails to load after POST, the storage drive containing the OS—such as the HDD—has failed or is not properly connected. An audio card is non-essential for booting, while a failed CPU or power supply would prevent the system from passing POST at all.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：过 POST 说明电源 CPU 正常，进不去系统查硬盘（HDD/SSD）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Passes POST (CPU/RAM/PSU good) + fails to load OS = storage drive (HDD/SSD) issue.

stem.zh: 以下哪项是使用 VDI（虚拟桌面架构）的优势？
stem.en: Which of the following is an advantage of using VDI?

options.text: Authentication is not required on a domain.
Less manual configuration is needed for each workstation.
A virus is automatically contained locally.

explanation.zh:
【考点：虚拟桌面架构（VDI）的优势】
虚拟桌面架构（VDI）将桌面环境集中托管在后端服务器上，通过统一的黄金镜像快速分发和更新桌面，从而大幅减少了对每台终端工作站进行手动配置和维护的工作量。使用 VDI 依然需要域身份验证；后端服务器和虚拟化授权成本通常较高；且病毒会发生在集中托管的虚拟会话中，而非“自动限制在本地终端”。
explanation.en: Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) centralizes desktop environments on backend servers using standardized master images, which dramatically reduces the need for manual configuration and maintenance on individual client workstations. Users still require domain authentication, backend virtualization and licensing costs are often high, and malware runs on the centralized virtual desktop rather than being contained locally on the physical endpoint.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：VDI 桌面集中管，单机无需逐台配。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Main benefit of VDI = centralized management and less manual setup per workstation.

stem.zh: 一名技术人员正在排查公司统一配发的同款平板电脑上的手写笔（Stylus）问题。用户可以自行购买配件。部分用户没有遇到任何问题，但其他用户反映他们的手写笔充电断断续续且频繁没电。以下哪项是导致该问题最可能的原因？
stem.en: A technician is troubleshooting stylus issues on identical, company-provided tablets. Users can purchase their own accessories. Some users have no issues, but others report that their styluses charge intermittently and die frequently. Which of the following is the most likely cause of this issue?

options.text: Certain cases are causing charging issues.
The tablets need to be updated.
Some of the tablets have manufacturing defects.
The malfunctioning styluses need firmware updates.

explanation.zh:
【考点：移动设备配件兼容性与手写笔磁吸充电故障】
平板电脑的手写笔通常通过磁吸贴合在机身侧面进行无线/触点充电，对物理贴合度要求极高。由于公司配发的平板完全相同，且允许用户自行购买第三方配件，部分用户购买的保护壳（Cases）过厚或开孔设计不当会阻挡手写笔与机身充电区域的接触，导致充电断断续续、频繁没电。系统更新、批次制造缺陷或固件问题均不如第三方保护壳物理遮挡更契合题意。
explanation.en: Magnetic wireless-charging styluses attach to the side of a tablet and rely on close physical proximity to charge. Because the tablets are identical and users buy their own third-party accessories, thick or improperly designed tablet cases are the most likely cause of intermittent physical contact and charging failure. Tablet OS updates, batch manufacturing defects, or stylus firmware updates would not selectively align with user-purchased accessories.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：同款平板自购配件致手写笔充电断续，必查保护壳（Cases）物理阻挡。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Identical tablets + user-bought accessories + intermittent stylus charging = third-party cases blocking the charger.

stem.zh: 一位小企业主购买了一栋办公楼并希望建立互联网连接。技术人员检查了目标网络机房，发现了一个同轴电缆（Coaxial）墙面插座。技术人员最可能推荐以下哪种互联网连接类型？
stem.en: A small-business owner purchases a building and wants to establish an internet connection. A technician examines the target network room and discovers a coaxial wall jack. Which of the following internet connection types would the technician most likely recommend?

explanation.zh:
【考点：互联网接入类型与同轴电缆（Cable Internet）】
有线电视宽带（Cable internet，基于 DOCSIS 标准）使用同轴电缆（Coaxial cable）传输信号。既然机房内已经有同轴电缆墙面插座，推荐有线宽带（Cable）可以直接利用现有布线连接 Cable modem 上网。光纤宽带（Fiber）需要光纤入户与光猫（ONT）；DSL 使用传统电话铜线（RJ11）；卫星宽带（Satellite）则需要在室外安装对准天空的卫星天线，通常用于无地面宽带覆盖的偏远地区。
explanation.en: Cable internet (DOCSIS broadband) uses coaxial cabling terminated at a coaxial wall jack with an F-type connector, making it the most logical recommendation when coaxial infrastructure is already present in the network room. Fiber requires optical fiber cabling, DSL uses copper telephone lines (RJ11), and satellite requires an outdoor dish with a clear line of sight to the sky rather than relying on an existing indoor broadband coax drop.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：墙上有同轴（Coaxial）接口，宽带首选有线宽带（Cable）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Existing coaxial wall jack in network room = recommend Cable internet.

stem.zh: 哪种 RAID 类型提供双重奇偶校验（Double parity）？
stem.en: Which RAID type offers double parity?

explanation.zh:
【考点：RAID 6 双重奇偶校验（Double Parity）】
RAID 6 采用条带化并带有双重分布式奇偶校验（Double parity），最少需要 4 块硬盘，允许同时损坏任意两块硬盘而不丢失数据。RAID 0 只有条带化没有校验；RAID 1 采用磁盘镜像没有校验；RAID 5 仅提供单重奇偶校验（Single parity），只能容忍一块硬盘故障。
explanation.en: RAID 6 stripes data across at least four drives with double distributed parity, allowing the array to withstand the simultaneous failure of up to two drives without data loss. RAID 0 uses striping with no parity, RAID 1 uses disk mirroring with no parity, and RAID 5 uses single distributed parity (tolerating only one drive failure).

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：单校验选 RAID 5（容错一盘），双校验选 RAID 6（容错两盘）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Single parity = RAID 5 (1 drive failure); Double parity = RAID 6 (2 drive failures).

stem.zh: 用户报告在访问托管于远程办公室的内部网站时出现间歇性延迟。技术人员应该执行以下哪些操作？（选两项）
stem.en: A user reports intermittent latency when accessing an internal website hosted at a remote office. Which of the following should a technician do? (Select two)

explanation.zh:
【考点：网络间歇性延迟（Latency）诊断命令（ping -t 与 tracert）】
排查访问远程办公室内部网站的间歇性延迟时，运行 `ping -t` 可以持续发送 ICMP 请求，从而捕获特定时间段内出现的间歇性高延迟或丢包；运行 `tracert` 可以逐跳（Hop）追踪本地到远程服务器路径上经过的每个路由器，定位究竟是哪一跳出现了延迟瓶颈。`ipconfig /all` 和 `nslookup` 用于查看本地 IP 配置和 DNS 解析；在未定位瓶颈前直接检查物理交换机端口、配置 QoS 或联系 ISP 均不符合排查流程。
explanation.en: To diagnose intermittent latency to a remote office, running `ping -t` sends continuous ICMP echo requests over time to catch sporadic latency spikes or packet loss, while `tracert` measures response times across each router hop along the path to pinpoint where the bottleneck occurs. `ipconfig /all` and `nslookup` check local IP configuration and DNS resolution rather than path latency, checking a local switchport or calling the ISP is premature before isolating the hop, and configuring QoS is a remediation step rather than a diagnostic tool.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：间歇延迟查远端，`ping -t` 持续测丢包，`tracert` 逐跳找瓶颈。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Troubleshoot intermittent remote latency = `ping -t` (continuous test over time) + `tracert` (isolate the slow hop).

stem.zh: 与使用公有云相比，使用混合云（Hybrid cloud）具有以下哪项优势？
stem.en: Which of the following is an advantage of using a hybrid cloud instead of a public cloud?

options.text: Ability to meet data residency requirements
Ability to leverage IaaS and PaaS

explanation.zh:
【考点：混合云（Hybrid Cloud）与数据驻留合规性（Data Residency）】
混合云结合了私有云（本地数据中心）与公有云服务，其核心优势在于允许企业将受法律法规严格监管的敏感数据保留在本地私有环境中，以满足数据驻留（Data residency）和合规性要求，同时利用公有云扩展其他业务负载。相比纯公有云，混合云需要同时维护本地和云端环境，管理开销更高；而跨平台虚拟化以及使用 IaaS 和 PaaS 在纯公有云中同样可以实现。
explanation.en: A hybrid cloud combines private (on-premises) infrastructure with public cloud services, allowing an organization to keep regulated or sensitive data inside its own local data center to satisfy strict data residency and compliance laws while still using the public cloud for general workloads. Public clouds actually have lower local management overhead than hybrid clouds, and both public and hybrid clouds can support cross-platform virtualization as well as IaaS and PaaS models.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：混合云胜公有云，敏感数据留本地，满足数据驻留（Data residency）合规要求。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Hybrid cloud vs. public cloud advantage = keeps sensitive data on-premises to meet data residency/compliance laws.

stem.zh: 一名用户在使用笔记本电脑和蓝牙（Bluetooth）耳机进行电话会议时，发现声音断断续续。该用户在通话期间经常把笔记本电脑留在原处，自己在不同办公室之间走动。办公室网络使用光纤互联网并连接了两个无线接入点（AP）。最可能的原因是什么？
stem.en: While using a laptop and Bluetooth headset for conference calls, a user notices intermittent sound issues. The user frequently walks between office rooms during calls, leaving the laptop in place. The office network uses fiber internet and has two connected APs. What is the MOST likely cause?

options.text: The number of available APs is inadequate.
The user is moving in and out of range.
The APs are not in mesh mode.
The internet connection is too slow.

explanation.zh:
【考点：蓝牙（Bluetooth）有效通信距离与故障排查】
蓝牙耳机（通常为 Class 2 蓝牙设备）的有效通信距离约为 10 米（33 英尺），且低功耗射频信号极易受墙壁和距离影响。当用户将笔记本留在原处而在不同办公室间走动时，耳机不断超出蓝牙有效覆盖范围，导致音频断续。无线接入点（AP）数量、Mesh 模式以及光纤网速仅影响网络连接，与笔记本和耳机之间的蓝牙本地连接无关。
explanation.en: Bluetooth Class 2 devices typically have an effective range of about 10 meters (33 feet), and walls or physical obstructions further weaken the signal. Because the laptop stays in one room while the user walks between office rooms, the headset moves in and out of Bluetooth range, causing intermittent audio dropouts. Wi-Fi AP count, mesh mode, and internet speed do not affect the local Bluetooth link between the laptop and headset.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：蓝牙耳机十米限，穿墙走远音断线。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Walking away from a stationary laptop with a Bluetooth headset causes audio dropouts due to exceeding the ~10m Bluetooth range.

stem.zh: 一名用户的笔记本电脑 USB 端口不够用了，但还想接入更多设备。哪种技术最合适？
stem.en: A user ran out of USB ports on their laptop but wants to plug in more devices. What technology is best?

explanation.zh:
【考点：笔记本扩展设备（端口复制器 Port Replicator）】
端口复制器（Port replicator）可通过单个接口（如 USB）为笔记本电脑扩展出多个额外的 USB 端口及其他接口，是解决有线 USB 接口不足的最佳方案。近场通信（NFC）仅用于极短距离的无线数据交换；蓝牙（Bluetooth）仅支持无线外设，无法插接有线 USB 设备；USB 接收器（USB receiver）仅用于连接特定的无线外设，还会额外占用一个 USB 端口。
explanation.en: A port replicator connects to a laptop via a single port (such as USB-C) and expands the number of available USB ports and other interfaces for wired peripherals. NFC is only for very short-range wireless data exchange, Bluetooth only connects wireless peripherals rather than wired USB devices, and a USB receiver typically pairs with a single proprietary wireless peripheral.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：U口不够插外设，端口复制来扩展。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Use a port replicator or docking station when a user needs more physical USB ports on a laptop.

stem.zh: 会议室的显示画面出现了与演示文稿不匹配的变形错位。以下哪项最能解决该问题？
stem.en: The display in a conference room has a burn-in get fastestthat does not match the presentation Which of the following would test resolve the issue?

explanation.zh:
【考点：投影仪梯形校正（Keystone Correction）】
当会议室投影仪或显示投影未与幕布保持垂直（存在上下倾斜角度）时，投射出的画面会出现梯形变形或边缘错位，与演示文稿比例不符，通过调整梯形校正（Keystone）即可恢复正常的矩形对齐画面。调整颜色设置（A）和提高亮度（C）只能改变色彩和明暗，无法解决画面几何形变与对齐问题；设备并未发生硬件损坏，因此无需更换显示器（D）。
explanation.en: When a projector is angled up or down relative to the screen, the projected image becomes trapezoidally distorted or misaligned with the screen borders, which is fixed using keystone correction. Adjusting color settings or brightness only changes visual appearance, and replacing the display is unnecessary when the issue is geometric projection alignment.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：投影画面歪斜不对齐，梯形校正（Keystone）调矩形。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: If a projected conference room image is skewed or misaligned with the screen, adjust the keystone setting.

stem.zh: 当计算机显示器出现闪烁时，技术员应该检查以下哪项？
stem.en: Which of the following should a technician check when the display of a computer Is flickering?

explanation.zh:
【考点：显示器故障排查（刷新率 Refresh Rate）】
显示器画面闪烁（Flickering）通常是由刷新率（Refresh rate，以 Hz 为单位，表示每秒重绘图像的次数）设置过低或超出了显示器支持的范围引起的，技术员应首先检查并调整刷新率。LCD 面板类型（A）和像素密度（D）属于固定的物理硬件属性，无法通过设置调节；屏幕分辨率（C）主要影响画面清晰度和显示比例，通常不会直接导致屏幕闪烁。
explanation.en: Display flickering is commonly caused by an incorrect or unsupported refresh rate (measured in Hz), which determines how many times per second the screen redraws the image. Checking and adjusting the refresh rate in the display settings resolves most flickering issues. LCD panel type and pixel density (PPI) are fixed hardware attributes, while screen resolution controls image sharpness and aspect fit rather than flicker.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：屏幕闪烁先查频，刷新率（Hz）设对画面稳。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Screen flickering is most commonly caused by an incorrect refresh rate (Hz) or a loose video cable.

stem.zh: 一名用户无法访问任何本地或远程资源。技术员运行命令查看配置信息，得到以下结果：IPv4 地址：192.168.1.10，子网掩码：255.255.255.0，默认网关：192.168.2.1。技术员向网络运营中心（NOC）核实，确认上游路由器配置正确，且告知技术员的下一跳地址与输出中的值一致。为了让用户的连接完全恢复正常，技术员应该修改以下哪项？
stem.en: A user cannot access any local or remote resources. A technician runs a command to find the configuration information and gets the following results: IPv4 Address: 192.168.1.10 Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0 Default Gateway: 192.168.2.1 The technician checks with the NOC, and it verifies that the upstream router is configured correctly. The next hop given to the technician matches the value in the output. Which of the following should the technician change in order for the user’s connection to work fully?

explanation.zh:
【考点：IPv4 子网掩码（Subnet Mask）与网关可达性排查】
在当前子网掩码 255.255.255.0（/24）下，主机 IP（192.168.1.10）位于 192.168.1.0 网段，而默认网关（192.168.2.1）位于 192.168.2.0 网段，主机与网关不在同一子网内会导致无法通信。由于网络运营中心（NOC）已确认上游路由器及下一跳网关地址无误，说明该网络实际采用了超网/更大子网（如 255.255.252.0），因此应修改客户端的子网掩码（E）。DNS 设置仅影响域名解析；网关已由 NOC 核实正确；租约时间和防火墙规则均与该网段不匹配问题无关。
explanation.en: With a subnet mask of 255.255.255.0 (/24), the host IP address 192.168.1.10 is on the 192.168.1.0 network, while the verified default gateway 192.168.2.1 is on the 192.168.2.0 network. Because the NOC confirmed the gateway IP is correct, the host's subnet mask is too restrictive and must be widened (for example, to 255.255.252.0) so both the host and gateway reside on the same local subnet. DNS settings only affect domain name resolution, and lease time or firewall rules do not fix a mismatched subnet mask.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：网关已核实却不同段，修改子网掩码扩范围。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: If the gateway IP is verified correct by the NOC but appears on a different third octet, fix the client's subnet mask.

stem.zh: 以下哪项会阻止虚拟机（VM）与网络或互联网上的任何终端进行通信？
stem.en: Which of the following would prevent a virtual machine from communicating with any endpoints on a network or the internet?

explanation.zh:
【考点：虚拟化安全隔离环境（沙箱 Sandbox）】
沙箱（Sandbox）是一种受严格隔离的虚拟环境，用于安全地测试可疑软件或未验证的代码，它会阻止虚拟机与局域网终端或互联网进行任何通信，从而防止恶意软件扩散。虚拟桌面基础架构（VDI）依赖网络连接来交付桌面；私有云（Private cloud）是云部署模型；Type 1 虚拟机监控程序（Hypervisor）直接运行在裸机硬件上，本身并不会默认阻断网络通信。
explanation.en: A sandbox is an isolated virtual environment designed to safely test untrusted code or applications by blocking communication with the host system, local network, and internet. VDI provides remote desktop sessions over a network, a private cloud is a deployment model for internal organization use, and a Type 1 hypervisor manages virtual machines on bare metal without inherently blocking network access.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：隔离测试防外联，沙箱（Sandbox）环境最安全。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: A sandbox isolates a VM from the network and host to safely test untrusted software or malware.

stem.zh: 一名员工正在出差，需要将每日的会议内容上传到公司内网。上传过程虽然成功，但速度比以前慢。以下哪项是导致速度变慢的最可能原因？
stem.en: An employee is on a business trip and needs to upload daily conferences and meetings to the company's intranet. The uploading process is successful but was faster in the past. Which of the following is the most likely reason for the slowdown?

explanation.zh:
【考点：移动网络数据限速（Data Throttling）】
数据限速（Data throttling）是指当移动网络用户达到流量上限或网络拥塞时，运营商主动降低其数据传输速率。题目中员工每天上传大量会议内容，上传仍能成功但速度明显变慢，正是典型的流量限速表现。如果关闭无线网络（A），上传将完全失败；关闭 5G（B）或开启漫游（C）都不是持续上传大流量后速度骤降的最主要原因。
explanation.en: Data throttling occurs when a mobile carrier intentionally reduces connection speeds after a user exceeds a data cap or during periods of high network congestion, allowing uploads to succeed but at a much slower rate. Turning off wireless would stop uploads completely, roaming simply connects via a partner network, and disabling 5G falls back to 4G/LTE rather than explaining a sudden policy slowdown after daily heavy uploads.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：出差传数能通却变慢，流量超限遭限速（Throttling）。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Successful transfers that suddenly become much slower on a mobile connection indicate data throttling by the carrier.

stem.zh: 一名用户的电脑连接在办公桌上的扩展坞（Docking station）上。尽管扩展坞已连接有线网络，但该用户仍无法访问部门文件服务器。技术员应采取以下哪项步骤来恢复用户的访问权限？
stem.en: A user's computer is connected to a docking station at their desk. The user cannot access the department file servers even though the docking station has a hardwired connection. Which of the following steps should a technician take to restore the user's access?

explanation.zh:
【考点：扩展坞有线与无线网络冲突排查】
当笔记本电脑连接到带有有线网线的扩展坞时，如果无线网卡（Wi-Fi）仍处于开启状态且连接到访客网络或受限 VLAN，系统可能会继续通过无线接口路由流量，从而导致无法访问部门内部文件服务器。禁用 Wi-Fi（C）可以立即强制电脑通过扩展坞的有线以太网接口访问内部局域网。更新扩展坞固件（A）、重启电脑（B）或更换网线（D）均未解决无线连接抢占路由优先级的问题。
explanation.en: When a laptop is docked with a wired Ethernet connection, remaining connected to a guest or restricted Wi-Fi network can prevent access to internal department file servers if the OS prioritizes the wireless interface. Disabling Wi-Fi forces the computer to route traffic through the docking station's wired Ethernet connection onto the corporate LAN. Updating dock firmware, restarting the computer, or replacing a working Ethernet cable does not address the wireless routing conflict.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：插坞有线访内网不通，先关 Wi-Fi 走有线。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: If a docked laptop on wired Ethernet cannot reach internal servers, disable Wi-Fi so traffic uses the corporate wired LAN.

stem.zh: 某金融机构的应用程序会在客户靠近支持非接触式支付的商店时向其发送通知。为了使该应用程序按预期工作，应启用以下哪两项功能？（选两项）
stem.en: A financial institution's application sends a notification to customers when a nearby store accepts contactless payments. Which of the following should be enabled so the application works as intended? (Select two)

explanation.zh:
【考点：移动设备定位服务（Location Services）与近场通信（NFC）】
定位服务（Location services）使应用能够获取用户的地理位置，从而在用户靠近支持非接触式支付的商店时发送通知；近场通信（NFC）则是实现非接触式刷卡支付及近距离终端交互的核心技术。移动设备管理（MDM）用于企业策略管控，联系人同步（B）、蓝牙（C）和个人热点（D）均不是实现商店地理围栏提醒与非接触式支付的标准组合。
explanation.en: Location services allow the mobile app to detect when the customer is physically near a participating store, while NFC (Near-Field Communication) enables contactless payment transactions at the point-of-sale terminal. MDM enforces enterprise device policies, contact syncing backs up address books, and Hotspot shares cellular internet, none of which handle proximity store alerts and tap-to-pay functionality.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：附近门店靠定位（Location），非接支付用 NFC。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Combine Location Services (for nearby store detection/geofencing) with NFC (for contactless mobile payments).

stem.zh: 一名无线网络管理员正在使用热力图（Heat map）规划公司的楼层平面布局。该管理员正在配置以下哪种类型的网络？
stem.en: An administrator for a wireless network is planning the company's floor plan using a heat map. Which of the following types of networks is the administrator configuring?

explanation.zh:
【考点：网络类型（无线局域网 WLAN 与热力图）】
无线局域网（WLAN）用于覆盖办公室、楼层或建筑等局部区域，网络管理员常使用信号热力图（Heat map）来规划办公楼层平面图中无线接入点（AP）的最佳部署位置并排查信号盲区。存储区域网络（SAN）用于连接高速存储设备；个人区域网（PAN）仅覆盖个人周边的短距离设备（如蓝牙）；城域网（MAN）覆盖整个城市范围，远大于公司楼层平面。
explanation.en: A WLAN (Wireless Local Area Network) covers a localized area such as an office floor or building, and administrators use Wi-Fi heat maps to visualize signal strength and optimize access point placement. A SAN is a dedicated high-speed storage network, a PAN covers personal devices within a few meters, and a MAN spans an entire city or metropolitan area.

mnemonic.zh: 口诀：楼层平面画热力图，无线局域网（WLAN）布 AP。
mnemonic.en: Exam Tip: Heat maps of an office floor plan are used to design and optimize AP placement for a WLAN.

stem.zh: 一名技术员正在将一台应用服务器迁移到另一台服务器。为了确保无缝连接，技术员应该创建以下哪种 DNS 记录？
